department: Electronic Engineering (School of Electronic Engineering and Computer Science)

deadline.value: No fixed closing date is given for applications; individual studentships set their own closing dates.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject requirement is mentioned on the pages checked.

supervisor.value: Applicants should choose a research group and try to identify a potential supervisor before applying. The school supervises only within its existing groups.
supervisor.quote: Read some recent publications from the group and try to identify a potential supervisor and research topic. | we are only able to supervise students with research interests that tie into our existing research groups

funding.value: The school offers a limited set of advertised studentships covering fees and a maintenance stipend.
funding.quote: Applications are invited for the following PhD Studentships in the School

also.quote: our studentships typically provide funding for up to 3 (Queen Mary) or 3.5 (EPSRC) years PhD study, covering tuition fees and a maintenance stipend

entry_route.value: The school normally expects an MSc in a relevant subject, with exceptions for applicants with particular qualifications or experience.
entry_route.quote: You should normally have an MSc in a discipline relevant to your proposed study

also.quote: Exceptions to this requirement may be made where you have particular qualifications or additional experience.

ielts_min.value: The school requires IELTS 6.5 overall with 6.0 in academic writing for applicants whose first language is not English.
ielts_min.quote: If English is not your first language, you will need to achieve a minimum score of 6.5 in the IELTS test, including a score of 6.0 in the academic writing module.

notes: Shares the School of Electronic Engineering and Computer Science application rules with the computer science record.
